required.quote: The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of a license, certificate, or permit under this chapter to complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially.

name.quote: The board shall appoint a Physician Assistants Advisory Committee composed of four physicians, at least two of whom shall be members of the board, and four licensed physician assistants

is_mandatory.quote: A physician assistant licensed pursuant to this paragraph shall not be authorized to perform any medical acts of any sort except as approved for utilization by a physician in a job description pursuant to paragraph (2) of this subsection.

title_protection.quote: No primary supervising physician shall have more than eight physician assistants who have completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program licensed to him or her at a time

scope_protection.quote: Nothing in this Code section shall be construed to prevent a physician assistant licensed in this state who has completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program from administering conscious sedation or anesthesia or to deem such physician assistant to be engaged in the unlawful practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certificate, or permit contained in this chapter or in board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certificate, or permit contained in this chapter or in the rules and regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in practice or in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a profession licensed, certified, or permitted under this chapter or in any document connected therewith

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of a felony in this or any other state, territory, country, or the United States.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a felony in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, country, or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed a crime involving moral turpitude, without regard to conviction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed a crime involving moral turpitude, without regard to conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority, or denied a license by any such authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license, certificate, or permit to practice pursuant to this chapter revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority; had other disciplinary action taken against him or her by any lawful licensing authority; or been denied a license by any lawful licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised for or solicited patients, obtained a fee on representation of incurable cure, or made untruthful statements about professional excellence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertised for or solicited patients; obtained a fee or other thing of value on the representation that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured; or made untruthful or improbable statements, or flamboyant or extravagant claims concerning his or her professional excellence or treatment protocols

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which need not have resulted in actual injury to any person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performed, procured, or aided or abetted in performing or procuring a criminal abortion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performed, procured, or aided or abetted in performing or procuring a criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided, assisted, or encouraged any unlicensed person or entity to practice, or divided fees for referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintained a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this chapter or the rules or regulations of the board; knowingly aided, assisted, procured, or advised any person to practice pursuant to this chapter contrary to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate a law, rule, or regulation of this state or any other state related to the practice of medicine, or violated a lawful order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate a law, rule, or regulation of this state, any other state, the board, the United States, or any other lawful authority without regard to whether the violation is criminally punishable, when such law, rule, or regulation relates to or in part regulates the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed any act or omission indicative of bad moral character or untrustworthiness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed any act or omission which is indicative of bad moral character or untrustworthiness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction, within or outside this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Become unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, alcohol, drug, or other substance use, or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become unable to practice pursuant to this chapter with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheated on or attempted to subvert a board examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheated on or attempted to subvert an examination by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed an act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed an act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation of a patient including guardians and parents of minors

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mistreated or abandoned a patient or the patient's records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mistreated or abandoned a patient or his or her records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered into conduct which discredits the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into conduct which discredits the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish records to the board in response to a subpoena or failed to answer renewal questions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to furnish records, including, but not limited to, medical records, to the board in response to a subpoena or failed to answer questions on the renewal of the license, certificate, or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain appropriate medical or other records as required by board rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to maintain appropriate medical or other records as required by board rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to follow generally accepted infection control procedures or OSHA standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to follow generally accepted infection control procedures or Occupational Safety and Health Administration standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with federal laws and standards relating to the practice of medicine or health care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with federal laws and standards relating to the practice of medicine or other health care profession regulated under this chapter, the regulations of drugs, the delivery of health care, or other related laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order for child support.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with an order for child support as defined by Code Section 19-11-9.3

definition_quote.value: physician assistant means a skilled person who is licensed to a supervising physician and who is qualified by academic and practical training to provide patients' services not necessarily within the physical presence but under the personal direction or supervision of the supervising physician.
definition_quote.quote: "Physician assistant" means a skilled person who is licensed to a supervising physician and who is qualified by academic and practical training to provide patients' services not necessarily within the physical presence but under the personal direction or supervision of the supervising physician.

value: administering conscious sedation or anesthesia under supervising anesthesiologist
performing medical tasks as approved in job description
ordering controlled substances and dangerous drugs as delegated
issuing prescription drug orders for Schedule III-V controlled substances
methods_authorized.quote: Nothing in this Code section shall be construed to prevent a physician assistant licensed in this state who has completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program from administering conscious sedation or anesthesia or to deem such physician assistant to be engaged in the unlawful practice of medicine.

drug_authority.value: A physician assistant who has completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program may administer anesthesia and conscious sedation. More broadly, a physician assistant may be delegated authority to order Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substances and dangerous drugs via prescription drug order in accordance with an approved job description.
drug_authority.quote: a physician may delegate to a physician assistant, in accordance with a job description, the authority to issue a prescription drug order or orders for any device as defined in Code Section 26-4-5 or to issue any dangerous drug as defined in Code Section 16-13-71 or any Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance as defined in Code Section 16-13-21 on a prescription drug order or prescription device order form

supervising_anesthesiologist_ratio.quote: No primary supervising physician shall have more than eight physician assistants who have completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program licensed to him or her at a time or supervise more than four physician assistants who have completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program at any one time.

supervising_anesthesiologist_physical_pr.quote: Nothing in this article shall prohibit the rendering of services to a patient by a physician assistant who is not in the physical presence of the supervising physician

written_practice_protocol_required.quote: At all times while providing patient services, a physician assistant shall have a signed job description submitted by his or her primary supervising physician and approved by the board.

value: Except for physician assistants who have completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program, the general PA supervision ratio limitations do not apply in hospitals, colleges/universities, Department of Public Health, county boards of health, community service boards, free health clinics, birthing centers, qualifying nonprofit entities, and qualifying HMOs. Anesthesiologist assistant program graduates are subject to a separate cap at all settings.
practice_setting_restrictions.quote: Except for physician assistants who have completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program, the limitation in paragraph (1) of this subsection shall not apply to a physician assistant who is practicing: In a hospital licensed under Title 31

prescribing_authority.quote: Nothing in this Code section shall be construed to authorize the written prescription drug order of a Schedule I or II controlled substance.

authorized_anesthesia_tasks.quote: Nothing in this Code section shall be construed to prevent a physician assistant licensed in this state who has completed a board approved anesthesiologist assistant program from administering conscious sedation or anesthesia

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.value: A licensed physician who is designated as the primary supervising physician and whose job description for the anesthesiologist assistant is approved by the Georgia Composite Medical Board; must be a physician lawfully licensed in this state to practice medicine and surgery.
supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: "Primary supervising physician" means the physician to whom the board licenses a physician assistant pursuant to a board approved job description and who has the primary responsibility for supervising the practice of a physician assistant pursuant to that physician assistant's job description.

national_certification_body.value: National Association for the Certification of Anesthesia Assistants (NACAA)
national_certification_body.quote: the National Association for the Certification of Anesthesia Assistants, (NACAA) or its successor.

accredited_training_program_required.quote: Evidence of satisfactory completion of a training program approved by the board. If the applicant is not a graduate of an accredited school approved by the board, he or she shall be required to receive board approved refresher training and testing

student_trainee_exemption.quote: The performance of: Any medical task by a student enrolled in a medical school, osteopathic medical school, or physician assistant training program approved by the board

supervising_anesthesiologist_liability.quote: The delegating physician shall remain responsible for the medical acts of the physician assistant performing such delegated acts and shall adequately supervise the physician assistant.

patient_disclosure_required.quote: Any physician, clinic, or hospital using a physician assistant shall post a notice to that effect in a prominent place.
